name: image
summary: Draws the image or video unchanged, as a GL copy that page flights and other effects build on.
looks: Looks exactly like the element: the same object-fit, object-position, border-radius and clipping. It is what a keyed image flies as between pages.

frames.note: Only when the layout or the picture changes; none at rest. A playing video draws its frames.

reducedMotion.note: Unchanged, it does not move.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition.

touch: The same as with a mouse.

cost.gpu: One textured quad.
cost.memory: One texture the size of the decoded picture.

name: ripple
summary: Rings spread from the pointer while the image is hovered.
looks: The picture ripples like water around the pointer: round rings whose crests catch a little light, calm right under the pointer. The rings fade out with the distance and settle when the pointer leaves, so at rest the copy matches the image.

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the rings displace the picture.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Rings across the image: higher is denser.

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast the rings travel outwards.

frames.note: While hovered and while the hover fades out; none at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Runs with hover held at 0, which shows the image unchanged.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition.

touch: Off on touch screens, where nothing hovers: the image stays DOM. An entry with `when: "all"` turns it on.

cost.gpu: One textured quad with a few math operations per pixel.
cost.memory: The shared texture of the image.

name: bend
summary: Scroll speed bends the image like paper and splits its color channels.
looks: While the page scrolls the image bows against the motion, like paper dragged through air, and its red and blue channels drift apart. It straightens as the scroll slows, so at rest the copy matches the image.

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the image bows at full scroll speed.

params.name: split
params.description: How far the red and blue channels drift apart.

frames.note: While the page scrolls and its speed settles; none at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Runs with scroll velocity held at 0, which shows the image unchanged.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition.

touch: The same on touch: it follows the scroll.

cost.gpu: A 32 x 32 grid and three texture reads per pixel.
cost.memory: The shared texture of the image.

name: reveal
summary: The image wipes in with a soft noisy edge as it scrolls into view, or fades, opens in bands or from the center.
looks: When enough of the image has entered the viewport, it is uncovered from one side by a soft edge with an uneven, inky rim, while the picture settles from a slight zoom. Once revealed it is the image as it is, pixel for pixel. Images that were already on screen when the page loaded stay as they are: nothing the visitor has seen disappears to play an intro. Other styles fade it in with a short drift, open it in bands one after another, or open a circle from the center.

params.name: style
params.description: wipe uncovers it with an uneven edge; fade fades it in, drifting 40 px along the direction; blinds opens it in bands one after another; iris opens a circle from the center, for a centered subject.

params.name: trigger
params.description: view plays when the image enters; scroll ties it to the scroll position, both ways.

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the wipe travels: up uncovers from the bottom. The fade drifts the same way; the iris ignores it.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the reveal.

params.name: delay
params.description: Wait after the trigger, for a cascade across a grid.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Share of the image height that must be in view, above the bottom tenth of the viewport, before it plays.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Scale the picture settles from; 1 or 0 for none.

params.name: softness
params.description: Width of the soft edge as a share of the image; uneven in wipe and iris, plain in blinds.

params.name: seed
params.description: Shape of the uneven edge.

frames.note: Only while revealing, and with trigger scroll while scrolling; none at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the image is shown as it is, and the engine does not load for it.

presence.note: Leaving a page closes the wipe again, entering opens it. A flight target lands on the revealed image.

touch: The same as with a mouse: it follows the scroll.

cost.gpu: One texture read of the image and one of a small noise tile per pixel.
cost.memory: The shared texture of the image and a shared 64 x 64 noise tile.

name: parallax
summary: The image drifts inside its frame with the pointer and the scroll; with a depth map, in 2.5D.
looks: The picture is shown slightly enlarged and moves within its box: away from the pointer while it is over the image, and down through the frame as the page scrolls, centered when the box is centered. With a depth map (a grayscale image of the same frame, white is near) near parts move more than far ones and pass in front of them, so a flat photo turns into a shallow 3D scene. Where depth jumps sharply the far side shows a stretched sliver; a slightly blurred map hides it.

params.name: depth
params.description: How far the pointer moves the picture, as a share of the box.

params.name: scroll
params.description: How far the picture travels while the box crosses the viewport.

params.name: ease
params.description: How softly the picture follows the pointer.

params.name: map
params.description: URL of a depth map for the same frame, white near; empty for a flat shift.

params.name: focus
params.description: Depth that stays put, 0 far to 1 near; nearer parts move one way, farther the other.

frames.note: While the pointer moves over it and the motion settles, and while scrolling; none at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the image is shown as it is, and the engine does not load for it.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition. A keyed flight carries the framing it had.

touch: The pointer part is off on devices without hover, so taps do not jolt the picture; the scroll part works.

notes.low: Depth search in 3 layers, refined 3 times.
notes.medium: Depth search in 6 layers, refined 4 times.
notes.high: Depth search in 10 layers, refined 5 times.

cost.gpu: One texture read per pixel; with a depth map 7 to 16 reads of the map, by quality tier.
cost.memory: The shared texture of the image, plus the depth map. A map half the size of the image, as a grayscale PNG, is enough.

name: gallery
summary: A container of images shows one at a time and changes them with a displacement, a slide, a crossfade or a zoom.
looks: The container shows one of its images, framed by that image’s own object-fit and object-position. A change runs a soft noisy wave across the picture that pushes the old one out and draws the new one in, slides the new one over the old, crossfades, or fades the new one in as it settles from a zoom. A whole index changes to its picture, a fraction from a tween holds the exact point between two, and clicks, swipes and the interval timer move the index too. Without WebGL the container is the layout you wrote, every image and alt text in place; keep captions and controls outside it, since its copy covers the whole box.
target: a container of images, such as a scroll-snap strip

params.name: index
params.description: Picture shown from 0, counting on past the last when it loops; a fraction holds a point between two.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of a change.

params.name: style
params.description: displace pushes the pictures with a noisy wave; slide moves the new one in from the side, like a carousel; fade crossfades, for a calm page; zoom fades the new one in as it settles from a zoom, for a hero slideshow.

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the displacement pushes the pictures.

params.name: interval
params.description: Time before the next picture, 0 for none; the timer pauses on hover and with focus inside.

params.name: click
params.description: A click on the container shows the next picture.

params.name: swipe
params.description: A horizontal swipe changes the picture; needs touch-action: pan-y on the container.

params.name: loop
params.description: After the last picture comes the first. Off, the ends hold: a click or swipe past them does nothing and the interval timer stops at the last.

params.name: items
params.description: Selector of the images inside the container.

params.name: seed
params.description: Shape of the displacement.

frames.note: Only during a change; none at rest. The interval timer draws nothing while it waits, and it pauses under the pointer, with focus inside, off screen and in a background tab.

reducedMotion.note: Every change is a short crossfade, and the interval timer does not advance.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; a keyed flight carries the current picture.

touch: A tap shows the next picture. A swipe works when the container has touch-action: pan-y, so the page keeps vertical scrolling; without it the gesture belongs to the page.

cost.gpu: Two or three texture reads per pixel, four during a displacement.
cost.memory: Up to three pictures at a time, the current one and its neighbors, however long the gallery is.

events.name: dio:index
events.description: A picture is reached, at the end of a change or when a tween stops on a whole index; index is its place among the pictures, from 0. Bubbles, for captions, dots and counters.

name: ambient
summary: A soft glow in the colors of the frame around a video or an image, like ambient mode.
looks: Around the box lies a large, heavily blurred copy of the frame’s main colors that fades out past the edge. While the video plays the light follows its frames a few times a second and flows from color to color; on pause it stands still. The video itself stays DOM: native controls, captions, fullscreen and picture-in-picture work as without the effect. As a shadow the light falls below the box instead, narrower than it, like a drop shadow in the picture’s colors under a cover or a card. Best on dark pages; the glow is not cut by an ancestor’s overflow, unlike box-shadow.

params.name: style
params.description: glow lights all around the box, like ambient mode; shadow falls below it like a colored drop shadow, for covers and cards on light pages too.

params.name: strength
params.description: Strength of the glow at the edge of the box.

params.name: spread
params.description: How far the glow reaches past the box, as a share of its shorter side, at most 240 px.

params.name: blur
params.description: How much the colors of the frame are blurred together.

params.name: saturation
params.description: Saturation of the light; 1 keeps the frame’s.

params.name: fps
params.description: Color updates a second while the video plays; 0 updates only on pause, seeking and start.

params.name: ease
params.description: Time the light takes to flow to new colors.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Width of the grid of colors read from the frame; its height follows the frame.

frames.note: At most fps a second while the video plays and while colors flow; none on pause or for an image once its colors are in. Scrolling moves the glow at full rate without reading the frame again.

reducedMotion.note: The light changes only on start, pause and seeking, flowing for a second, so it does not breathe with the video.

presence.note: The glow fades with the page as it leaves.

touch: The same as with a mouse; the quality tiers lower the update rate on weak devices.

notes.low: At most 4 updates a second from an 8-cell grid.

cost.gpu: One plane the size of the box and its glow, one read of a tiny texture per pixel.
cost.memory: A few kilobytes. Each update draws the frame into a 16 × 9 canvas and reads it back on the CPU.

name: hover-preview
summary: Over a list of projects, the picture of the item under the pointer follows the pointer, stands beside the item or holds a fixed place.
looks: While the pointer is over an item, its picture floats at the pointer: it appears from a slight shrink, trails behind with a stretch along the motion, a soft bow and a tilt from the speed, and crossfades into the next item’s picture with a small settle. Leaving the list fades it out. In beside mode the picture stands next to the hovered item’s text and glides from row to row; in fixed mode it holds one place by the list and only crossfades. The list stays as you wrote it: text, links, focus and selection are the DOM, nothing is hidden.
target: a list of links, such as an index of projects

params.name: mode
params.description: follow floats the picture at the pointer; beside places it after the item’s text, gliding between rows, for a wide list; fixed keeps it at the middle of the list moved by offset, for a preview column next to the list.

params.name: items
params.description: Selector of the items inside the list.

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the picture.

params.name: ratio
params.description: Width over height of the picture frame; auto takes the proportions of the picture.

params.name: ease
params.description: How far the picture trails the pointer or the row, as a time constant.

params.name: stretch
params.description: Stretch and bow from the pointer’s speed; 0 keeps the picture flat.

params.name: tilt
params.description: Most tilt from horizontal speed.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the appearance and the crossfade.

params.name: offset
params.description: Shift of the picture’s center from the pointer, the item or the list’s middle, x and y down as in CSS.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius of the picture.

frames.note: Only while the picture appears, moves, crossfades or leaves; none at rest, and pointer moves elsewhere on the page draw nothing.

reducedMotion.note: The picture sits at its place without stretch, tilt or trailing; it appears and changes by a 0.15 s fade.

presence.note: The picture fades with the page as it leaves.

touch: Not loaded on touch screens: the effect only runs where (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) match, and the list stays a list.

cost.gpu: One small plane of 16 × 16 cells over everything, two texture reads during a crossfade.
cost.memory: Up to eight pictures at a time: the item, its neighbors and the latest ones. Keep them at 800 px or less on the long side.

name: sequence
summary: An image sequence scrubbed by scroll, frame by frame, from a poster .
looks: The image becomes a flip book driven by the sticky section it sits in: scrolling down plays the frames forward, scrolling up plays them back, the way product pages take a device apart. Each frame is framed by the object-fit and object-position of the . With blend, neighboring frames mix by the fraction of the index, so a short sequence of 24 to 36 frames moves smoothly.

params.name: frames
params.description: Frame URLs by commas, or a range like /seq/{0001..0096}.webp padded as its first number.

params.name: atlas
params.description: Atlas pages instead of frames, a range or list; cells read left to right, top to bottom.

params.name: grid
params.description: Columns and rows of cells on an atlas page.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of frames; auto takes all of the range, or every cell of every atlas page.

params.name: by
params.description: What drives the frame: pin of the sticky section, viewport progress, or frame alone.

params.name: start
params.description: Progress at which the first frame shows.

params.name: end
params.description: Progress at which the last frame shows.

params.name: frame
params.description: Frame shown when by is manual, for a tween or a slider; with blend a fraction mixes two.

params.name: blend
params.description: Mix neighboring frames by the fraction of the index.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing of the index behind scroll; 0 follows scroll at once (Lenis already smooths it).

params.name: cache
params.description: Decoded frames kept around the current one, two of them ahead in the scroll direction.

params.name: density
params.description: Share of the frames loaded: 0.5 loads every second one and the others show the nearest.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Longest side in px a frame is decoded at; larger frames shrink while decoding.

frames.note: Scroll draws its own frames; a frame that finishes decoding asks for one, and ease keeps drawing until the index settles. None at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the shows its poster and not a single frame is downloaded. The poster is what people with reduced motion and without WebGL see, so choose it on purpose; another still frame for them is a with .

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; a keyed flight carries the frame shown at the time.

touch: Works as on desktop: scroll drives it.

notes.medium: Up to 4 decoded frames, decoded at up to 1440 px.
notes.low: Every second frame, up to 2 decoded frames at up to 960 px.

cost.gpu: Two texture reads per pixel of the box; one upload of the frame per drawn frame at most.
cost.memory: The compressed bytes of every frame it loads, cache decoded frames on the CPU and one texture of a frame on the GPU (two with blend). An atlas holds its pages instead, .webp, .avif or .ktx2 images, and compressed .ktx2 pages take 4 to 8 times less GPU memory. Under Save-Data or on 2G it loads a quarter of the frames at up to 960 px.

name: expand
summary: The image of a card grows to fill its sticky stage as the section scrolls.
looks: Between start and end of the pin a copy of the image grows from the box of its card to the box of the sticky stage, usually the whole screen, easing in and out. Its corners go to radius, object-fit frames it anew at every size, so cover never stretches, and the content swells a little on the way and lands at its size. It then holds the screen; when the section lets the stage go, it leaves with it. With out below 1 it folds back into the card before the pin ends. Scrolling up plays it all backward.
target: img, video inside a card on a sticky stage

params.name: into
params.description: Selector of the ancestor to grow into; empty for the nearest sticky one, or the viewport.

params.name: by
params.description: What drives it: pin of the sticky section, viewport progress, or position alone.

params.name: position
params.description: Expansion by hand, for a button or a GSAP tween; with pin or progress it is a floor.

params.name: start
params.description: Pin at which it starts to grow.

params.name: end
params.description: Pin at which it fills the stage.

params.name: out
params.description: Pin from which it folds back into the card; 1 holds it to the end.

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much the content swells halfway, back to 1 at both ends; 1 or 0 for none.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius once it fills the stage.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing behind scroll; 0 follows it at once (Lenis already smooths it).

frames.note: Scroll draws its own frames, ease keeps drawing until it settles. None at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the image stays in its card, as the DOM shows it.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition. A keyed flight takes the copy and starts from the box it was drawn at, expanded or not.

touch: Works from scroll. On iOS without Lenis the full-screen copy can trail composited scroll by a frame as the stage is let go; Lenis avoids it.

cost.gpu: One texture read per pixel, up to the whole viewport once expanded.
cost.memory: The image the browser picked for the card. For a sharp full screen, let sizes allow it, such as sizes="100vw".

name: zoom-scroll
summary: A picture in a pinned section zooms from its box to fill the screen as you scroll.
looks: While the section is pinned, between start and end, a copy of the picture grows from its box to the box of the sticky stage, usually the whole screen. zoom scales the picture up with its box and pushes in a little more; mask keeps the picture still at its full-screen framing and opens a rounded window onto it, the picture easing back from zoom as the window opens; through grows it, flies past the screen and fades out to show the content behind. Corners go from the element radius to radius. Scrolling up plays it backward; reverse plays it from the full screen into the box.
target: img, video on a sticky stage inside a tall section

params.name: style
params.description: zoom grows with its box; mask opens a window on a still picture; through flies past.

params.name: start
params.description: Pin at which the zoom starts.

params.name: end
params.description: Pin at which it fills the screen, or for through has faded out.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Extra zoom of the picture: push-in for zoom, start zoom for mask, 2x for through; 1 or 0 for none.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius once it fills the screen.

params.name: reverse
params.description: Plays it backward: full screen at the start of the pin, back in its box at end.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing behind scroll; 0 follows it at once (Lenis already smooths it).

frames.note: Scroll draws its own frames, ease keeps drawing until it settles. None at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the picture stays in its box, as the DOM shows it.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; a keyed flight starts from the box it was drawn at.

touch: Works from scroll. On iOS without Lenis the full-screen copy can trail composited scroll by a frame as the stage is let go; Lenis avoids it.

cost.gpu: One texture read per pixel, up to the whole viewport once zoomed.
cost.memory: The image the browser picked for the box. For a sharp full screen, let sizes allow it, such as sizes="100vw".

name: compare
summary: Two pictures in one box, before and after, split by a line you drag, hover or scroll.
looks: The first image shows up to the line and the second after it. The line has a round handle with arrows and a hard or soft edge; in lens mode a circle at the pointer shows the second image instead. The line follows a drag, the pointer, the scroll of a pinned section or the param, and wiggles once when the box first shows.
target: a container with two images and an <input type="range">

params.name: position
params.description: Line position as a share of the box along direction; dragging writes it.

params.name: by
params.description: What moves the line: drag by hand; hover follows the pointer; scroll a pinned section; manual.

params.name: direction
params.description: x moves a vertical line sideways; y moves a horizontal one.

params.name: mode
params.description: split draws a line between the images; lens shows the second image in a circle at the pointer; fade crossfades the whole box from the second image (position 0) to the first (position 1), for then-and-now photos taken from the same spot.

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the lens.

params.name: softness
params.description: Softness of the border between the images; not used by fade.

params.name: thickness
params.description: Width of the line, 0 for none.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the line and the handle.

params.name: handle
params.description: Draws a round handle with arrows on the line.

params.name: start
params.description: Section progress where scrolling starts to move the line.

params.name: end
params.description: Section progress where scrolling stops moving the line.

params.name: hint
params.description: Wiggles the line once when the box first shows.

params.name: items
params.description: Selector of the two images inside the container.

frames.note: Only while the line eases or the hint plays; none at rest, and pointer moves outside the box draw nothing.

reducedMotion.note: No hint and no easing: the line follows input at once.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; a keyed flight carries the current split.

touch: A tap moves the line to the point. Dragging works with touch-action: pan-y (pan-x for direction y); hover acts as drag.

cost.gpu: Two texture reads per pixel and a distance field for the handle.
cost.memory: Both images as textures.

name: zoom
summary: Hovering an image shows a sharp, magnified view of it under the pointer.
looks: Over the image a high-resolution version shows magnified zoom times. In inner mode the whole box shows it and follows the pointer without empty margins; in lens mode a round loupe with a glassy rim; in side mode another element shows it and the image marks the area. Until the large file arrives the image itself is magnified, then it crossfades.

params.name: mode
params.description: inner fills the box, lens shows a loupe, side uses another element.

params.name: trigger
params.description: hover shows the view while the pointer is over the image; click shows it on a click and hides it on the next click or when the pointer leaves, so moving across the page does not zoom.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Magnification over the shown picture.

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the loupe.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing of the view following the pointer.

params.name: full
params.description: URL of the large picture; empty takes a linked image, srcset or currentSrc.

params.name: into
params.description: Selector of the empty element that shows the view in side mode.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Cap on the long side when decoding the large picture.

frames.note: Only while the view appears, follows or leaves; none at rest, and pointer moves outside the image draw nothing.

reducedMotion.note: No smoothing and no fade: the view follows the pointer at once.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; a flight starts without magnification.

touch: Not loaded on touch screens: it runs where (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) match. With when: all, a tap toggles the view at its point, and a drag moves it where the image has touch-action: none or pinch-zoom.

notes.medium: Decodes at most 3072 px on the long side.

name: lightbox
summary: A click opens an image full screen: its copy flies out of the grid, pages and zooms.
looks: A click lifts the image out of the grid towards the viewer and carries it to the center of the screen while its crop opens to the full picture, the rest of the grid sinks back and the backdrop darkens; the large file crossfades in after the flight. Inside, arrows, buttons and swipes page, and a double click, the wheel or a pinch zoom. Escape, the close button, a click on the backdrop, a swipe down or scrolling the page brings it back to its place the same way.
target: a container of linked images, or one img

params.name: index
params.description: Open picture from 0, -1 when closed; the effect writes it, the site can open one.

params.name: items
params.description: Selector of the images that open; ignored on a single img.

params.name: motion
params.description: How the picture opens and closes: lift arcs it towards the viewer, tipped back and leaning into the move, while the grid sinks back; fly carries it flat; zoom grows it straight to the center while the grid sinks back; flip turns it over like a card on the way; fade dissolves it in place without a flight.

params.name: margin
params.description: Space around the open picture, and at least the band a shown caption takes.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Zoom limit over the fitted picture, never below 1:1 of the source; 0 turns zoom off, so the wheel, a pinch, a double click and the + - 0 keys do nothing.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the flight in and out.

params.name: backdrop

name: flipbook
summary: The page images of a container become a book whose pages bend as they turn.
looks: Pages show as a spread of two, or one on a narrow box. Closed on its cover the book stands in the middle of the box; as the cover turns the book slides so the open spread is centered on its spine, and closed on the back cover it stands in the middle again. A turning page bends around a fold from the spine, the fold is shaded and a shadow falls on the page below. A page follows the finger or the mouse from a corner or an edge and, let go, finishes the turn or falls back; a click on a closed book opens it and a click on a half of a spread turns forward or back, and with tabindex on the container the arrows, PageUp, PageDown, Home and End turn too. The images stay in the page in order, so screen readers read them; give the text as HTML or PDF as well, pictures of pages are neither searched nor translated.

name: glitch
summary: A digital glitch in short bursts: blocks slide sideways, color channels split, scanlines flicker.
looks: For a fraction of a second the picture breaks up: horizontal blocks jump sideways and wrap around, red and blue part ways, scanlines darken and the frame flickers, with flashes of static. The pattern jumps twenty times a second and the burst stutters, so it reads as a broken signal rather than an animation. Between bursts the copy is the image as it is. The same seed gives the same glitch on every visit.

params.name: shade

params.name: perspective

params.name: click

params.name: pause

params.name: items

name: polaroids
summary: Photos scattered like prints on a table: drag one to the top, click it to hold it up large.
looks: Each image becomes a print with a white border and a wider bottom edge, lying at a small angle with a soft shadow: scattered over the box, over the places the page gives the images, or in a loose pile. A drag lifts a print, carries it on top of the others and puts it down where it is let go. A click brings a print to the top; a click on the top one holds it up in the middle, straight and larger, while the others dim, and a click anywhere or Escape puts it back. A print whose image is a link follows it instead.
target: a container of images: a trip, an event, a studio

params.name: index
params.description: Print on top, from 0.

params.name: open
params.description: Print held up in the middle, from 0; -1 for none.

params.name: style
params.description: scatter spreads the prints over the box; grid lays each over its image as the page places it, like a pinboard; pile heaps them near the middle.

params.name: rotate
params.description: Largest angle of a print; 0 lays them straight.

params.name: spread
params.description: How far the prints stray from their places, 0 for none.

params.name: border
params.description: Width of the paper border; the bottom one is 3.4 times wider. 0 for bare photos with the images’ own corners.

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the paper border.

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadow under each print, 0 for none.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Largest size of a print held up, in its own sizes, never past nine tenths of the box; 0 never holds one up.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of a print’s move.

params.name: drag
params.description: A drag carries a print.

params.name: seed

params.name: items
params.description: Selector of the images inside the container.

name: spotlight
summary: A flashlight over a photo: the image darkens around a soft circle at the pointer.
looks: While the pointer is over the image, everything outside a circle of radius px around it fades toward color by dim, and the circle trails the pointer by ease. In reveal style the circle shows a second picture instead, like an x-ray or a before and after; in blur style the outside is also blurred by blur px. When the pointer leaves, the light closes and the image returns to its full look, or to a resting dim set by rest.

params.name: style
params.description: light darkens the rest; reveal shows the src picture in the circle; blur blurs the rest too.

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the lit circle.

params.name: softness
params.description: Share of the radius that fades from light to dark: 0 is a hard edge.

params.name: dim
params.description: How far the image outside the light goes toward color: 0 keeps it as is.

params.name: color
params.description: Shade the outside fades toward, black by default.

params.name: blur
params.description: Blur radius outside the light in blur style.

params.name: rest
params.description: Share of dim kept while the pointer is away: 0 shows the full image at rest.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing of the light following the pointer: 0 sticks to it.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the fade as the light comes on and goes off.

params.name: src
params.description: URL of the picture the circle shows in reveal style.

frames.note: Only while the light fades or trails the pointer; none at rest, and a still pointer draws nothing.

reducedMotion.note: No fade and no smoothing: the light appears, jumps and goes at once.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; a flight carries the image without the light.

touch: The light follows a finger while it is pressed and goes when it lifts. Add touch-action: none to the image to keep a drag from scrolling the page.

cost.gpu: One texture read per pixel; 17 in blur style, 2 in reveal style.
cost.memory: The image, plus the second picture in reveal style.

name: scrub
summary: A video scrubbed by scroll: its time follows the sticky section it plays in, forward and back.
looks: While the section pins its stage, scrolling down plays the video forward and scrolling up plays it back, the way product pages turn a device or take it apart. Every frame the browser decodes crossfades from the one before for as long as the frames take to come, at most blend, so the picture moves smoothly even when seeks lag behind the scroll and stays sharp when they keep up. Frames are framed by the object-fit and object-position of the video. Encoding decides how smooth it is: give the file a keyframe every few frames (ffmpeg -g 5, or -g 1 for every frame) and enough frames for the scroll, 24 to 30 a second, since a few frames stretched over a long scroll step however they blend; keep it short and at most 1080p, with no sound; a file from a phone or an editor has a keyframe every few seconds, and every seek backwards then decodes up to that many frames.
target: video, muted, with preload="auto" and a poster of its first frame

params.name: by
params.description: What drives the time: pin of the sticky section, viewport progress, or position alone.

params.name: start
params.description: Progress at which the scrubbed span begins.

params.name: end
params.description: Progress at which the scrubbed span ends.

params.name: position
params.description: Place in the span shown when by is manual, for a tween or a slider.

params.name: from
params.description: Time in the video the span starts at.

params.name: to
params.description: Time in the video the span ends at, in seconds; auto is the end of the video.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing of the time behind scroll; 0 follows scroll at once (Lenis already smooths it).

params.name: blend
params.description: Longest crossfade from one decoded frame to the next; frames that come quicker fade quicker. 0 cuts.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Longest side in px a frame is copied at; larger videos shrink on the GPU.

frames.note: Scroll draws its own frames; a decoded frame asks for one, and ease and blend keep drawing until the time and the crossfade settle. None at rest, and no seeks while the video is off screen.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the video shows its poster and is never seeked. People with reduced motion and without WebGL see the poster, so choose it on purpose.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition.

touch: Works as on desktop: scroll drives it.

notes.medium: Frames copied at up to 1440 px.
notes.low: Frames copied at up to 960 px.

cost.gpu: Two texture reads per pixel of the box, one frame copy and upload per decoded frame.
cost.memory: The video as the browser buffers it, and two copied frames on the GPU. A 4 second 1080p clip with a keyframe every 5 frames is about 2 to 4 MB as H.264 or VP9.

name: chroma
summary: A video shot on a green or blue screen, played over the page with the screen keyed out.
looks: The product or presenter stands on your page as if the video had transparency, from one ordinary MP4 or WebM that plays in every browser, Safari included, where WebM alpha does not play and HEVC with alpha is hard to make. Pixels close to the screen color turn clear, with a soft ramp at the edge; green that the screen threw onto the subject is taken out, fully at the edge and by spill inside, and the edge itself is averaged over a few neighboring pixels so it does not crawl. Before the video plays its poster shows keyed the same way.
target: video on a green or blue screen, muted for autoplay, with a poster of its first frame; your own play button and captions next to it

params.name: by
params.description: color keys out the screen param; auto reads the screen color every frame from whichever top corner of the frame is greener, for unevenly lit footage.

params.name: screen
params.description: Color of the screen to remove, green by default; #0047bb for blue.

params.name: similarity
params.description: How far from the screen color a pixel may be and still turn clear.

params.name: softness
params.description: Width of the soft ramp from clear to opaque past similarity; 0 cuts hard.

params.name: spill
params.description: Share of the screen’s hue taken out of the subject, all of it at the see-through edge; 0 keeps every color as shot.

params.name: blur
params.description: Distance in px of the neighbors each pixel’s key is averaged with; 0 is off.

params.name: crop
params.description: Share of the frame cut off at the top, right, bottom and left, for light stands and the screen’s end.

frames.note: One frame per video frame while it plays and is on screen, at the video’s own rate; none while it is paused, before it plays or off screen.

reducedMotion.note: Keyed as usual: keying is not motion. Whether the video plays is up to the site; under reduced motion, start it paused and let the visitor play it.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition.

touch: The same as on desktop; tapping works as the site’s own buttons do.

notes.low: No blur: one texture read per pixel instead of five.

cost.gpu: Five texture reads per pixel of the video’s box with blur, one without, and a small color transform.
cost.memory: One video frame on the GPU, and the poster until the video plays. The video itself is as large as the file: no second copy with alpha.

name: liquid
summary: The pointer leaves a fluid trail on a photo that settles back like water.
looks: Where the pointer passes, the picture bends as if seen through moving water: a wake follows the path, spreads, drifts a little and fades out over duration, after which the copy matches the image again. Unlike ripple, which draws rings around a hovering pointer for as long as it stays, liquid reacts only to movement, follows the path the pointer took and goes still on its own.

params.name: style
params.description: water refracts the picture by the slope of the wake and lights its edges; smear drags the picture along the path like a finger through wet paint; prism drags it and splits the trail into red and blue fringes.

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the trail moves the picture: 0 turns the effect off.

params.name: radius
params.description: Width of the trail around the path.

params.name: duration
params.description: Time the trail takes to settle after the pointer stops.

params.name: swirl
params.description: How much the wake drifts along itself as it fades: 0 keeps it in place.

params.name: shine
params.description: Light on the edges of the wake in water style: 0 refracts without light.

params.name: split
params.description: Width of the color fringes in prism style: 0 leaves the colors together.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Cells of the trail along each side of the image: more is finer and costs more CPU.

frames.note: Only while a trail is settling, about duration after the last move; none at rest, and a still pointer draws nothing.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the image stays DOM and nothing loads for it.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition, which takes the image without its trail.

touch: A pressed finger draws the trail. Without touch-action on the image a vertical swipe still scrolls the page, and the trail stops where the scroll takes over; add touch-action: none for drawing without scrolling.

cost.gpu: One texture read per pixel for the trail plus the picture; three in prism style.
cost.memory: A 64 × 64 half-float texture, 32 KB, besides the image.

name: horizontal
summary: A row of cards on a pinned stage slides sideways as the page scrolls down, its pictures bending with the speed.
looks: While the section is pinned, scrolling down moves the row of cards to the left, one pixel sideways per pixel of scroll. The pictures bow like paper dragged through air, shear or ride a wave across the screen, stretch a little with the speed and settle when the scroll stops; inside each card the picture drifts slower than its frame. The row is a real horizontal scroller, so links, focus, arrow keys and swipes move it too, and the page follows.
target: a row with overflow-x: auto (cards with images inside) on a sticky stage inside its section

params.name: style
params.description: bend bows each picture against the motion; skew shears it, top leading; wave sends one wave across the screen that the cards ride through.

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the pictures bend, shear or wave at full speed; 0 keeps them flat.

params.name: stretch
params.description: Extra width at full speed, as a share of the card; 0 for none.

params.name: parallax
params.description: How far the picture drifts inside its card as it crosses the screen, as a share of the card; 0 for none.

params.name: pace
params.description: Pixels of scroll per pixel the row travels: the effect sets the section height to fit. 0 keeps the height from your CSS.

params.name: reverse
params.description: Starts the row at its end and moves it right.

params.name: ease
params.description: How long the pictures take to follow the speed and flatten again.

params.name: items
params.description: Pictures in the row that get a bending copy.

frames.note: Scroll draws its own frames; ease keeps drawing until the pictures are flat. None at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the row stays a plain horizontal scroller in a section of its own height, and the engine does not load for it.

presence.note: The copies of the pictures fade with the page transition; the row itself is the DOM.

touch: Scrolling the page moves the row, and a sideways swipe on the row scrolls it natively while the page follows.

cost.gpu: One texture read per pixel of each picture, on a plane of 24 rows for bend and wave.
cost.memory: The textures of the pictures in the row.

children.description: Pictures inside the row (items): each gets a copy that bends; text, links and buttons stay DOM.

name: curtain
summary: A cover picture opens from behind a curtain as you scroll: strips slide away, halves part or a liquid edge drains past.
looks: The picture starts covered by a curtain of a solid color or a second picture. As the element scrolls toward the middle of the screen, or as its pinned section scrolls, the curtain opens and casts a soft shadow on the picture at its edge, while the picture settles from a slight zoom. strips slide off one after another, each carrying its slice of the curtain; split parts two halves from the seam, gathering in folds; liquid drains past with a wavy edge and a light rim. Scrolling back closes it again, and with out it closes before the section lets go. Once open it is the picture as it is.
target: img, video; for by pin, on a sticky stage inside a tall section

params.name: style
params.description: strips slide off one after another; split parts two halves from the seam with folds; liquid drains past with a wavy edge.

params.name: by
params.description: view opens it as the element scrolls from the bottom of the screen to its middle; pin follows the pinned section; manual only position.

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the curtain goes: up opens from the bottom. split parts sideways for left and right, up and down for up and down. auto parts split sideways, like a stage curtain, and lifts the others.

params.name: position
params.description: Opening set by hand, 0 shut to 1 open; with view or pin the least opening.

params.name: start
params.description: Progress at which it starts to open.

params.name: end
params.description: Progress at which it is open.

params.name: out
params.description: Progress from which it closes again; 1 keeps it open.

params.name: count
params.description: Strips of strips, folds of each half in split, waves of the liquid edge.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the curtain, or what shows while src loads.

params.name: src
params.description: A second picture to use as the curtain, framed like the image, such as a sketch, a title card or the brand pattern.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Scale the picture settles from; 1 or 0 for none.

params.name: shade
params.description: Depth of the shadow at the edge, the folds of split and the rim of liquid; 0 flat.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing behind scroll; 0 follows it at once (Lenis already smooths it).

params.name: seed
params.description: Shape of the liquid edge.

frames.note: Scroll draws its own frames, ease keeps drawing until it settles. None at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the picture is shown as it is, without the curtain, and the engine does not load for it.

presence.note: Leaving a page closes the curtain, entering opens it up to where the scroll has it. A picture on the first screen waits behind a veil until the curtain is drawn.

touch: The same as with a mouse: it follows the scroll.

cost.gpu: One texture read of the image per pixel, one more with src, and one of a small noise tile for liquid.
cost.memory: The image, the src picture when given and a shared 64 x 64 noise tile.

name: flare
summary: A lens flare or a glossy light sweep over a photo that follows the pointer or the scroll.
looks: A warm light source sits on the photo: a soft glow with a hot core and, in lens style, a row of tinted ghosts along the line from the light through the centre of the frame, like a real lens. In sweep style a glossy band runs through the light at angle and catches the highlights of the picture, the way light slides over chrome or a watch case. The light follows the pointer and fades out when it leaves, travels across the photo with the scroll, or stays put. It is screened over the photo, so it brightens without clipping to white.

params.name: style
params.description: lens draws a glow with ghosts along the axis through the centre; sweep draws a glossy band through the light that brightens the highlights.

params.name: by
params.description: pointer: the light follows the pointer and fades out when it leaves; scroll: it travels across the photo as the page scrolls; fixed: it stays at position.

params.name: strength
params.description: Brightness of the whole flare: 0 turns it off.

params.name: glow
params.description: Radius of the glow as a share of the photo's shorter side: 0 hides the glow.

params.name: ghosts
params.description: Number of ghosts along the axis in lens style, up to 8: 0 shows none.

params.name: streak
params.description: Brightness of a thin anamorphic streak across the frame, in a cool tint: 0 hides it.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the light; the streak takes a cooler shade of it.

params.name: position
params.description: Where the light rests, sits with by fixed and travels through with by scroll, as shares of the box from its top left.

params.name: travel
params.description: With by scroll, how far the light moves across the photo, as a share of its width: 0 keeps it at position.

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction the sweep band runs across, like a CSS gradient angle: 90 is vertical.

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the sweep band as a share of the photo's diagonal.

params.name: rest
params.description: With by pointer, the share of the light kept while the pointer is away, at position: 0 shows the plain photo at rest.

params.name: ease
params.description: Smoothing of the light following the pointer: 0 sticks to it.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the fade as the pointer light comes on and goes off.

frames.note: With by pointer, only while the light fades or trails the pointer; with by scroll, only while the page scrolls; none at rest and none with by fixed.

reducedMotion.note: No fade and no smoothing: the pointer light appears, jumps and goes at once. With by scroll the light stays at position.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; a flight carries the photo without the pointer light.

touch: With by pointer the light follows a finger while it is pressed and goes when it lifts; add touch-action: none to the image to keep a drag from scrolling the page. by scroll works the same on phones.

cost.gpu: One texture read per pixel and a handful of exponentials; the ghosts are math, not reads.
cost.memory: The image only.

name: frost
summary: Frosted glass over a photo, or over the whole page, that the pointer wipes clear and that slowly fogs back.
looks: The photo sits behind frosted glass: blurred, veiled in a pale tint and laced with ice crystals, or, in steam style, a fogged mirror dotted with droplets. Wiping the pointer across it clears a band with a ragged wet edge, which fogs back over refog seconds. Instead of wiping, the glass can clear from the pointer on hover, clear from the middle as the photo comes into view, or clear along with the scroll. On <body> the screen becomes a frozen window: feathers of ice grow in from the edges over a milky veil, glints catch the light near the pointer, and the page under it stays real, readable and clickable. On any other element the same pane covers its box. cover freezes the glass from the edges and thaws it outwards from a point.

params.name: style
params.description: frost: ice crystals over a milky layer; steam: a fogged mirror with droplets.

params.name: by
params.description: pointer: the pointer wipes the glass; hover: it clears from where the pointer came in and fogs back when it leaves; view: it clears once as the photo comes into view; scroll: it clears with the scroll between start and end. The pointer wipes in every mode but hover.

params.name: blur
params.description: Blur of the photo behind the glass: 0 keeps it sharp. The pane over a page draws no blur, since it never reads the page.

params.name: strength
params.description: How much the glass veils the photo in color: 0 leaves only the blur.

params.name: grain
params.description: Strength of the ice crystals, or the share of droplets in steam style: 0 is plain glass.

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the wipe under the pointer.

params.name: refog
params.description: Seconds a wiped area takes to fog back, and with by hover the fog after the pointer leaves: 0 keeps it clear.

params.name: refill
params.description: How much of the fog comes back over a wiped area: 1 all of it, 0.3 a thin layer that keeps the page readable, 0 none.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the clearing with by hover and by view, and of a freeze or thaw.

params.name: start
params.description: With by scroll, the scroll progress at which the clearing begins: 0 as the photo enters at the bottom.

params.name: end
params.description: With by scroll, the scroll progress at which the glass is clear: 0.5 is about the photo centred in the viewport.

params.name: cover
params.description: How much of the glass is frozen: rising, ice grows in from the edges over duration; falling, it thaws outwards from x, y. 0 is bare glass. Live, so a script or a scroll handler can freeze and thaw the page.

params.name: x
params.description: Where a thaw starts, from the left edge of the box (the viewport on <body>).

params.name: y
params.description: Where a thaw starts, from the top edge.

params.name: middle
params.description: How much thinner the ice is in the middle of the pane, so text there stays readable: 0 frosts it evenly, 1 leaves the middle clear. Screens without hover use at least 0.6.

params.name: keep
params.description: A CSS selector of up to six elements the pane keeps a thin veil over, such as the headline and the button, so they stay readable under thick ice. Read when the effect starts; a photo ignores it.

params.name: color
params.description: Tint of the glass, a cold white by default.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Cells across each side of the wipe mask: more gives a finer edge.

frames.note: Only while the pointer wipes, while a wipe fogs back, while a clearing plays and while the ice grows or thaws; none at rest. With by scroll only while the page scrolls.

reducedMotion.note: No animated clearing, freeze or thaw: they jump to where they end. On a photo wiping still works and wiped areas still fog back. The pane over a page is only a faint cold tint without crystals, and nothing wipes it.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition; no wipes are taken while it plays.

touch: On a photo a pressed finger wipes the glass; a scroll takes the gesture, so add touch-action: none to the image to wipe without scrolling. The pane over a page never takes a gesture: every touch clears the ice around it, also while it scrolls, and the middle stays thin. With by hover a tap clears the glass for good. by view and by scroll need no gesture.

notes.low: Blur at most 6 px with 8 reads instead of 16; a 32 × 32 mask. The pane drops its finest crystals.

cost.gpu: On a photo seventeen texture reads per pixel for the blur (nine on low), two of the noise tile and one of the mask; steam adds one for the droplets. The pane reads the noise tile four times and the mask once per pixel of its area, with no blur.
cost.memory: The image, a shared 128 × 128 noise tile and a mask of resolution × resolution bytes × 4.

name: reflection
summary: A soft reflection on a glossy floor under a product photo, without baking it into the image.
looks: Below the image the picture is mirrored, as if the product stood on polished stone or glass: the reflection starts at the product's base, fades out over reach of the image's height and blurs with distance. For a cutout with transparent padding the base is its lowest solid row, so the reflection touches the product, not the edge of the file. A contact shadow can ground it, and a ripple turns the floor into still water.

params.name: strength
params.description: Opacity of the reflection at the base: 0 hides it and leaves only the shadow.

params.name: reach
params.description: How far the reflection runs down, as a share of the element's height.

params.name: blur
params.description: Blur at the far end of the reflection, growing from sharp at the base: 0 is a mirror.

params.name: gap
params.description: Space between the base and the reflection; negative pulls it up.

params.name: trim
params.description: Mirror at the lowest solid row of a transparent picture and at the drawn bottom under object-fit; false mirrors at the bottom of the box.

params.name: ripple
params.description: Sway of a water ripple in the reflection: 0 is a still floor.

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of a soft contact shadow under the base: 0 draws none.

params.name: fps
params.description: Frames a second the ripple draws at while visible.

frames.note: Once when it appears and on layout changes; with a ripple, at most fps a second while visible. None at rest.

reducedMotion.note: The ripple stands still; the reflection itself is not motion.

presence.note: Fades with the page transition.

touch: The same as on desktop: the reflection does not react to input.

notes.low: No blur, one texture read per pixel of the reflection; the ripple at most 15 frames a second.

cost.gpu: Twelve texture reads per pixel of the reflection for the blur and eight for the shadow, only below the image.
cost.memory: The image as a texture; the element itself stays DOM.
